basis: Original clean-context A→B→A Discovery videos, telemetry and 5% safety samples for desktop, portrait and landscape. Boundaries below are approximate capture targets, not claims that progress itself defines a semantic state. Desktop samples p005–p100 and corresponding portrait/landscape states were inspected. Subsequent semantic pass and reconciliation remain pending.

milestones.label: M01
milestones.observedChange: The initially frontal ink elevation rotates into an oblique relief view while its same central door, balcony and windows remain identifiable.

milestones.label: M02
milestones.observedChange: A luminous boundary starts crossing the row; drawn facade and brick/material representation coexist on the same house geometry.

milestones.label: M03
milestones.observedChange: The row is fully materialized, with the same central openings, balcony and neighboring volumes, while front elevation framing remains readable.

milestones.label: M04
milestones.observedChange: The daylight direction and facade shadows move after materialization; the same architectural edges cast the changed shadows.

milestones.label: M05
milestones.observedChange: The camera leaves the street-wide facade framing and approaches the central oak door, steps and porch recess.

milestones.label: M06
milestones.observedChange: The front oak door turns inward while the camera reaches the threshold; the entrance hall remains aligned behind the original facade opening.

milestones.label: M07
milestones.observedChange: The camera is inside the reception parlour, with the continuous stair, floor, bookcase, seating and glazed rear direction visible.

milestones.label: M08
milestones.observedChange: The route advances to kitchen/dining atrium, including table, island, tall rear glazing and tree beyond; its floor and walls connect to the parlour.

milestones.label: M09
milestones.observedChange: Rear steel glazed doors open toward the same walled courtyard and tree seen from within the dining space.

milestones.label: M10
milestones.observedChange: The camera passes through the rear doors into the courtyard; brick enclosure and tree remain spatially continuous with the atrium view.

milestones.label: M11
milestones.observedChange: The route stabilizes near the rear courtyard wall and tree with donor-authored property/booking copy. No further natural input reveals a new state in Discovery.

reverseSemanticStates: Inspect continuous B→A Discovery for rear/front door closure, material sweep inversion, sun/shadow reset, camera/optic return, intro/HUD return and any asymmetry. Compare A0/A1 across all viewports; use VISUALLY_EQUIVALENT unless internal state restoration is directly demonstrated.
